Latitude.note: A trade article dated 30 March 2026 puts the Tiefstack power plant site in Hamburg-Billbrook, where a heat storage tank is now being built on the plant grounds. A map lookup of the Tiefstack power plant gives about 53.5269 north and 10.0649 east, roughly 110 meters from the point GEM holds. So the existing coordinates match the plant site. The article does not print coordinates itself.

GEM shows one combined cycle unit of 127 MW. The old note on the unit also talks about a coal to biomass plan that was dropped. Not a task in this batch.
